extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying for ANR grants (and ANR peer reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation rules and criteria used by the Agence nationale de la recherche (ANR) to assess pre-proposals and full proposals in two phases, including top-level criteria, sub-criteria, process principles, and scoring conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and scientific aims of the proposal (determining criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality and scientific aims of the proposal — identified as the determining criterion in Phase 1 (pre-proposal) and used as a key evaluation axis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in both Phase 1 and Phase 2; evaluated via sub-criteria such as scientific and technical quality, originality and innovation, soundness of approach, risk assessment, position relative to state of the art, and scientific ambition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organisation and implementation of the project
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation and implementation of the project — a core evaluation criterion (present in Phase 1 and Phase 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessed through sub-criteria including quality and complementarity of the consortium or investigator, adequacy of resources requested, suitability of timeline, project management and coordination, and risk mitigation strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact (Phase 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Impact considerations — an explicit key criterion at the full proposal (Phase 2) stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers scientific impact, economic and social impact, dissemination plan, open science practices, and training of young researchers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific and technical quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientific and technical quality — a sub-criterion under Quality and scientific aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators assess the technical rigor and scientific soundness of the proposed research and methods; considered when determining the proposal's overall scientific merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality and innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Originality and innovation — a sub-criterion under Quality and scientific aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses the novelty of concepts, approaches or expected contributions relative to existing work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Soundness of approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Soundness of approach — a sub-criterion under Quality and scientific aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether the methodology/planned approach is appropriate, coherent and feasible to achieve the stated aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Risk assessment — a sub-criterion under Quality and scientific aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators consider identification of scientific/technical risks and the plan to manage or mitigate them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position relative to state of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Position relative to state of the art — a sub-criterion under Quality and scientific aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses how the proposal relates to current knowledge and whether it advances beyond existing research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific ambition
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientific ambition — a sub-criterion under Quality and scientific aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers the scale and ambition of the scientific objectives and potential to substantially advance the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and complementarity of the consortium (PRC) or individual investigator
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality and complementarity of the consortium (PRC) or individual investigator — a sub-criterion under Organisation and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether team members' expertise are appropriate and complementary for the project goals; for individual proposals, assesses the investigator's qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adequacy of resources requested
rubrics_metrics.description: Adequacy of resources requested — a sub-criterion under Organisation and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses whether requested funding and resources are appropriate, justified and sufficient for the project's aims and timeline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability of timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Suitability of timeline — a sub-criterion under Organisation and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates whether the proposed schedule is realistic and aligned with project objectives and milestones.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project management and coordination
rubrics_metrics.description: Project management and coordination — a sub-criterion under Organisation and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses plans for managing the project, internal coordination among partners, governance structures and responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk mitigation strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Risk mitigation strategies — a sub-criterion under Organisation and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates planned measures to anticipate, reduce or respond to identified project risks (technical, managerial, operational).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific impact (advancement of the field)
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientific impact — a sub-criterion under Impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers the proposal's potential to advance scientific knowledge and influence the research field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic and social impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Economic and social impact — a sub-criterion under Impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses potential benefits to the economy, society, industry or policy; relevance outside academia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissemination plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Dissemination plan — a sub-criterion under Impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates plans to share results (publications, conferences, outreach) and reach relevant stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open science practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Open science practices — a sub-criterion under Impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers commitments to open access, data sharing, reproducibility and other open science measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training of young researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Training of young researchers — a sub-criterion under Impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses how the project will train and develop early-career researchers and contribute to capacity-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjectival ratings (A+ to C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjectival Ratings — ANR uses adjectival ratings, generally with categories such as A+ (excellent) through C (insufficient).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scoring is reported with broad adjectival categories rather than only numeric scores; these categories inform selection decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of same criteria by panel members and external experts
rubrics_metrics.description: Panel members and external experts use the same set of criteria to evaluate pre-proposals and full proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures consistency between internal panel reviews and external expert assessments across both phases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent assessment and call-specific criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects assessed independently based on criteria specific to the call.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each project is evaluated independently and may be judged against additional or tailored criteria stated in the specific funding call.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial independent scoring (no discussion before initial scoring)
rubrics_metrics.description: No discussion with the panel before initial scoring — reviewers provide initial independent scores prior to panel discussion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages unbiased first impressions and independent evaluations before any group influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer commitments: ethics, integrity, confidentiality, conflicts
rubrics_metrics.description: Before accessing project documents, panel members commit to: Respect ANR code of ethics and scientific integrity; Respect the French National Charter for Research Integrity; Protect confidentiality of information; Declare no conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirement for reviewers to ensure ethical, confidential, and conflict-free evaluation; noncompliance can disqualify reviewers from assessment.
